testimonials.text: Kunal's contribution to the Education, Training and Assessment department has been tremendous. He is always ready for new challenges and loves to explore on upcoming technologies. He is an avid learner and keeps on participating in hackathons and coding competitions. His keen observations have helped in enhancing the value of the content being developed and delivered. With his strong technical and analytical skills, he has already created a name for himself. He is a valuable asset to our team.Glad to have you on the team Kunal!
